prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer from the information available—lawyer fit depends on your injuries, the facts, and the insurance issues. A good way to get a vetted shortlist is the **State Bar of California’s certified lawyer-referral service directory**: [calbar.ca.gov/find-lawyer-referral-service](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/public/find-legal-professionals/find-lawyer-referral-service). Certified services refer you to lawyers in good standing who carry professional liability insurance; the initial consultation may be free or reduced-fee.

You can also compare a couple of local firms, such as **GJEL** in Pleasanton or **Venardi Zurada**, but treat their websites and testimonials as advertising—not independent proof of quality. Before hiring anyone:

- Check the lawyer’s license and disciplinary history using the State Bar’s [Attorney Search](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/).
- Ask who will personally handle your case, how often you’ll get updates, and what similar injury cases they’ve handled.
- Get the contingency-fee percentage and responsibility for case costs in writing; ask what you would owe if there’s no recovery.
- Speak with at least two lawyers and choose the one who clearly explains your options and answers your questions.

Save accident, medical, and insurance records, and avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer before getting advice. If you tell me how seriously you were injured and whether the other driver’s insurer has contacted you, I can suggest what to prioritize when comparing attorneys.
